sahil.bansal212@example.com | +91 9735243367

Dynamic Data Scientist with experience building production ML and computer vision systems that drive measurable business impact. Strong background in end-to-end model development, experimentation, and deployment using Python, SQL, PyTorch and DL frameworks. Collaborative team player experienced in Agile environments and cross-functional delivery; available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience
CartNest — Jan 2023 - Present
Data Scientist (Remote)

- Built SQL-backed feature stores and pandas data pipelines to support real-time recommendation features; optimized queries and ETL to cut feature computation latency by 45% and increased recommendation throughput by 3x.
- Led A/B experiments and model monitoring to measure DL model drift; established alerting and rollback procedures integrated with Jira and Git, reducing incident resolution time by 35%.
- Collaborated with product and engineering teams in Agile sprints to prioritize use cases and deploy models to production containers; maintained reproducible training code and version control using Git.

Vertex Analytics — Apr 2022 - Dec 2022
Machine Learning Engineer (On-site)
- Developed end-to-end Machine Learning models for customer segmentation and churn prediction using Python and pandas; lifted predictive precision by 18% versus baseline and demonstrated 12% potential uplift in retention when applied to pilot cohort.
- Implemented feature engineering pipelines and SQL data pulls for model training, reducing data preparation time by 50% and enabling weekly model retraining cycles.
- Applied ML model validation and performance tracking, and collaborated via Jira to manage sprint tasks and deployment timelines; contributed code and reviews through Git.
- Automated model scoring and reporting to stakeholders, producing dashboards that shortened decision cycles and improved targeting efficiency.

Projects
- Visual SKU Normalizer — Built a prototype Computer Vision tool using PyTorch and DL techniques to normalize diverse product images into canonical orientations and background removal, achieving 88% normalization success on a noisy dataset.
- Churn Risk Dashboard — End-to-end pipeline using pandas and SQL to score customers nightly for churn risk and generate prioritized outreach lists; integration reduced manual list preparation time by 70%.
